interpretation: Positive references are provisional. Omitted IDs include unresolved candidates, not only verified negatives. Source-market scope does not verify formulation or page claims.
assumptions: Unqualified named products refer to their standard formulation rather than an explicitly differentiated sugar-free, reduced-sodium, gluten-free, UV, THINS or other competing line.
Pack-size changes and refills do not alone establish a different product.
Dedicated product documents, recipes and bundle sections can reference the product without being retail listings.
Targets are US-market versions. Market does not imply US manufacture or verified formulation equivalence.
